body:
## Parent

https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/43

## What to build

On the laptop, a fresh installation and each legacy unconfigured slot show the owner's four usable starting presets. Existing configured custom presets and alerts survive the update, restart and local backup/restore. Applying a saved preset from the riding preset menu uses its explicit dip-inclusion choice while retaining its remembered dip locally.

Follow #43, the agreed domain glossary, ADR 0002 (Keep preset editing separate from wheel application) and the confirmed preset-editor interaction specification. #43 supersedes conflicting #41/#42 requirements; those tickets are not prerequisites. This slice establishes the versioned configuration contract and reusable migration/application fixtures consumed by the watch slice. The editor transaction and gesture revisions are subsequent slices.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] New configuration contains exactly these configured fixed slots, with dip inclusion off in all four:

  | Slot | Name | Dynamic assist | Pedal sensitivity | Remembered dip |
  | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
  | 1 | Jump | 0 | 0 | 0 |
  | 2 | Forest | 0 | 70 | 0 |
  | 3 | Road | 25 | 30 | 10 |
  | 4 | Drag | 70 | 20 | 5 |

- [ ] Introduce a new configuration schema version with independently persisted whole-percentage dip value and explicit inclusion. All active readers/writers, observable configuration views and preset application consumers preserve that meaning, including existing editor consumers during this transition. The names and values remain ordinary editable custom definitions; no immutable-mode behavior or reset on startup/update is introduced. Road is a fixed baseline, never a wheel read.
- [ ] Explicitly migrate schema 1: preserve fixed IDs, configured names, sensitivity, assist and alerts; a present dip, including zero, retains its value with inclusion on; absent dip retains omission and gains only the corresponding slot's default remembered dip; an unconfigured slot becomes the complete corresponding default. Migration is deterministic and idempotent, sends no wheel I/O and does not repeatedly change revisions or replace valid custom content on reload.
- [ ] Durable load, previous-good recovery and local export/import/restore accept known legacy content through that migration. Review shows migration effects before an imported replacement is committed. New exports retain omitted dip values and inclusion and exclude telemetry, live wheel settings, drafts, pending commands and confirmation. Preserve size/validation limits and stale-preview revision guards.
- [ ] Unknown schemas, corrupt/invalid content and oversized input produce explicit validation/recovery outcomes; they must not be mistaken for a fresh installation and silently overwrite custom presets. A valid legacy previous-good copy remains usable even when it is the only valid copy. Migration/replacement keeps a validated recovery route through failed or interrupted writes, including the first persisted configuration.
- [ ] Both visible preset lists expose the four configured saved names. A riding-menu tap still immediately starts the existing serialized preset operation with an immutable request from saved values. Explicit inclusion filters dip; numeric presence must not include it accidentally. Omitted zero/nonzero dip emits no dip command, whereas included zero uses the existing zero-valued command. No extra Apply step, confirmation dialog or stopped-only restriction is added.
- [ ] Local configuration changes retain existing revision invalidation of pending/currently confirmed preset operations. Command mappings, submission/confirmation bounds and failure behavior remain unchanged. Laptop/watch configuration synchronization remains withdrawn.

## Tests and evidence

- Reuse the public application action/raw-notification/observable-view/command-output seam, real durable store and existing local backup UI/backend flows. Use independent literal expectations, not private helper tests or expected values calculated by the implementation.
- Retain sanitized reusable versioned input/expected-output fixtures covering fresh configuration, mixed configured/unconfigured slots, custom names/values, included zero/nonzero dip, absent dip and nondefault alerts. Observe results through load, reviewed import, save/export and restart; repeat load and compatible startup to prove idempotence. Include all-legacy-unconfigured input and a legacy recovery copy as the only valid copy.
- Through the built laptop UI/backend, verify the four exact names and configured state in both preset lists. Apply every default using the existing simulator/controlled live-transport boundary and assert exact sensitivity/assist packets and no dip packet; start with a different simulated wheel dip and prove it stays unchanged. Separately apply included zero/nonzero dip.
- Inject refused/failed replacement, interrupted migration/first save, corrupt active content and unsupported schema at the file adapter boundary; assert saved custom content, recovery warnings and no wheel packets. Check stale import previews cannot overwrite a newer save.
- Update affected existing schema/application/backup regressions and run focused checks plus frontend typechecking/build. Record expected/observed saved state, packets and provenance for reuse by the watch ticket; this is offline software evidence.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).
title: Initialize laptop editable presets with lossless schema migration
